page.overview:
Who is Oileus?

Oïleus (Ὀϊλεύς) was the king of Lokris, and an Argonaut. His father was listed as being Hodoedokus (whom Oileus succeeded as King of Lokris) and his mother as Agrianome (daughter of Perseon), according to Hyginus's Fabulae.

Oileus gets wounded in the shoulder during the attack of the Stymphalian Birds on the Argo and receives aid from Eribotes.

"Oileus, son of Hodoedocus and Agrianome, daughter of Perseon, from the city Narycea."- Hyginus, Fabulae, 14 Category:Argonauts
